self_falsification.finding: The lane's headline claim ('elicitation and falsifiability are disjoint across all 111 surfaces; nothing does both') was FALSIFIED by the lane's own check against raw rows. github/spec-kit mandates NEEDS-CLARIFICATION markers AND Given/When/Then acceptance scenarios in one template; Fission-AI/OpenSpec pairs a clarify-before-code flow with SHALL/WHEN/THEN scenarios.
self_falsification.correction: Narrowed to: no commercial surface (0 of 51) does both; the two OSS projects that do combine them by convention with NO enforcing engine, so the combination is asserted rather than computed. The design consequence strengthens rather than weakens: enforce mechanically, because convention without an engine is what the OSS half already proves insufficient.
